title: Visiting Professor of Practice
bio: Brian Wolfman is Professor from Practice and the Director of the new full-time, semester-long Appellate Courts Immersion Clinic at Georgetown Law, which he founded in 2017. He is also the Faculty Director of Georgetown Law’s Blume Public Interest Scholars Program. He was previously a Professor of the Practice of Law and Co-Director of Stanford Law […]
